notes.title: P.T.'s Winter Extravaganza
notes.content:
It's that time of year again! Grab a cup of your favorite hot cocoa and warm up your hooves for some winter fun in Unicorn Tails!

Today and throughout January, enjoy wintertime fun activities. P.T. has figured out how to use his magic game machine to open a new portal on Unicorn Island. Transport yourself to a snow-covered land filled with presents, butterflies, and surprises!

[list]
[*] Open presents that have been scattered around for some unique holiday hats.
[*] Enjoy ice skating on the frozen pond!
[*] Beat your high scores skiing down the giant slalom!
[/list]

And it wouldn’t be Unicorn Tails if there weren’t some secrets buried about. Learn new magic to make it snow any time you want! Unlock even more butterflies with some wintertime target practice.

It’s P.T.’s Spectacular Winter Extravaganza!

notes.title: Steam Deck Update for Unicorn Tails
notes.content:
Greetings everyone!

Just a small update from the Unicorn Kingdom. We at RavenFist finally opened a chocolate bar and got a golden ticket! By which I mean we got a Steam Deck and have begun the process of making sure everything in Unicorn Tails works as expected. If you’ve been wanting to play Unicorn Tails on the go, or have kids and you’re willing to hand them an expensive, limited availability device this should be good news.

On the flip-side, if you’ve been enjoying Unicorn Tails on a Steam Deck already, post your experiences. We’d love to hear about them and hear how we can make Unicorn Tails on Steam Deck the best it can be.

Work continues on our second game, and we still haven’t forgot about the new story content for Unicorn Tails. We’re working hard and look forward to sharing more in the future!

RavenFist Studios

notes.title: 2021 Roadmap
notes.content:
First of all, yes, we know it’s July. We’re sorry. Publishing a roadmap when half of the year is gone is not high on the, “keep your community engaged” list.

Let me to explain.

No, there is too much.

Let me sum up.

We ended 2020 with a huge update to Unicorn Tails bringing full voice over to the game. We wanted to take that momentum into 2021 with a big announcement. What we discovered is that some things in the gaming industry move slower than one would hope. We also had to navigate the wonderful world of non-disclosure agreements for the first time. So, bear with me as I attempt to share with you what happened without violating a signed NDA.

Our highest priority in 2021 was to port Unicorn Tails to a small, handheld device that is black in the middle with interchangeable colors on the sides and rhymes with Tintendo Ditch. We spent from January to May trying to make this a reality. We feel, as developers, that one thing potentially holding Unicorn Tails back is platform. We developed for PC because we love PC, but our target market probably spends more time on platforms like the aforementioned handheld device. Getting the exposure of Unicorn Tails on that platform was a business move because the sad reality is that if these unicorns that we love so much don’t pay the bills, then there isn’t a lot more we can do with them. This is a sad truth for a young development company.

In May, we determined once and for all that porting Unicorn Tails to this new platform was not going to be possible. We do not have the resources that these magicians making incredible ports of AAA games have. To port Unicorn Tails ourselves would have meant rebuilding the game and removing so much of it that it wouldn’t have been the same game anymore. We toyed with the idea of Unicorn Tails: Ditch Edition (again, NDA), but that didn’t feel right to us either.

We found ourselves weighing two options. What’s best for RavenFist and what’s best for Unicorn Tails. This should not even be a question. What’s best for RavenFist is automatically what is best for Unicorn Tails, but we didn’t want to let any of you down. We didn’t want to let down the incredible cast of voice actors who made Unicorn Tails come alive in ways that we never anticipated. And, darn it, we like these unicorns.

Without further ado (even though you have already waded through much ado), here is our 2021 RavenFist Studios Roadmap:

1. Update Unicorn Tails with a new major quest.
2. Release RavenFist’s second game, hopefully before the end of the year.

Let’s speak about the update to Unicorn Tails first. We wanted to add something to the game before 2021 leaves us, so we have written a new quest and are in the process of developing it. It is a quest unlike anything you have ever encountered in Unicorn Tails. Our goal was to create something that brought a little more explanation to some of the odder aspects of Unicorn Tails. If you have enjoyed pouring through every book in the game and thinking about every piece of lore that we’ve dropped, then you will enjoy this quest. To set expectations, this will not be as long or involved as the main quest of the game. It is a self-contained story within the world of Unicorn Tails. I estimate that it will be about two extra hours of content, but we will know for sure when we start play testing. This will be a free update to Unicorn Tails and we expect to release it before the end of the year.

We will also be bringing back our Halloween seasonal event and our Winter seasonal event. Speaking personally, those were two of my favorite pieces of content. We added many players after those events had run last year, so it will be nice to revisit them.

Now, let’s talk about our second game. We want to keep updating Unicorn Tails, building on it, and bringing new players to the world. To be transparent as developers, Unicorn Tails has not sold the numbers we need. Believe me, we were being very conservative with our sales goals, but we still haven’t reached them. So, we have devoted time to designing and creating a second game from RavenFist Studios. Our hope is that having two games for sale will help sustain us and let us continue improving those games and creating more. We are not ready to announce this game in full yet, but here’s what I can tell you:

• It is a brand-new IP.
• It is not “made for kids” but it is still mostly kid friendly. (Think Looney-Tunes level of content.)
• It is a physics-based platformer.
• Our goal is to simultaneously launch the game on Steam and mobile platforms.

We are excited to share more about this game when the time is right.

There you go, that’s our roadmap. Feel free to post questions or comments here. You can always reach us at support@ravenfist.com or @RavenfistGames on Twitter.

Thanks to everyone who has purchased and played our game. It really is wonderful and humbling. We love hearing stories of young kids playing games for their first time. We love seeing fan art, gameplay guides, and speedruns. We may be a small community, but the love is surely felt.

Until next time,

RavenFist Studios

notes.title: The Talkie Update
notes.content:
Unicorn Tails Fans,

Prepare yourselves for the biggest update in Unicorn Tails history!

We started out making a game that would appeal to families.  We tried to make it friendly for all ages and accessible to everyone.  Today we have taken a huge step regarding accessibility.  RavenFist Studios is proud to 
announce that Unicorn Tails is now fully voice acted!

For all our young fans out there, who haven’t yet learned to read, are just learning to read, or struggle with reading, this will completely change the way they experience the game.  For everyone else, this will add whole new dimension of immersion into our crazy, mixed-up unicorn universe.

To help us achieve this update we had the generous help of some vocal rock stars.  Marissa Lenti (Borderlands 3) lent her voice to Unicorn Tails and along with Brendan Blaber (YouTube Channel JelloApocalypse) gathered, directed, produced, and recorded tremendously talented individuals to bring Unicorn Tails to life in a brand-new way.  Check out the game credits for a full list of the amazing talent behind this new feature in Unicorn Tails!

We hope that everyone has a great time meeting their favorite unicorn characters again, this time with voices!

Sincerely,
RavenFist Studios

[b]P.S. Even though we're launching the update today, Unicorn Tails will be on sale starting tomorrow, November 13th, for 15% off (Steam made us wait a day to drop the price).  We hope this new update will lead to more people experiencing and enjoying Unicorn Tails![/b]

Happy Hat Day! Okay, that's not actually a thing, but it is in Unicorn Tails - your unicorns can now wear all kinds of hats!

Top Hat? Check.

Knight Helmet? Check.

Unicorn Hat...on a unicorn? Check!

As always, thank you for playing Unicorn Tails, and we hope to hear from you. Be safe out there!

Sincerely,

Ravenfist Studios

notes.title: A Big Thank You and Survey Results
notes.content:
Hello all Unicorn Tails fans! 

We’d like to take a moment to give a special “thank you” to everyone who filled out our recent survey.  We received substantially more responses than we ever could have hoped for.  

And now, in no particular order, the top 5 scoring categories that you would like to see added to Unicorn Tails: 

- More Quests 

- Multiple Save Files 

- Cosmetic Items 

- Seasonal Events 

- More Lands to Explore 

We are happy to announce today that we are working on all five to make Unicorn Tails a better game! 

Not only that, but we have a big surprise up our sleeves that wasn’t even mentioned in the survey. 

But we’re not just here to announce that we’re working on the additions and changes that you have requested.  We’re also here to share a rough release schedule with you. 

Before September ends, the first batch of cosmetic items will be added to Unicorn Tails.  Keep your eye on the release notes and keep checking the bazaar in the castle for a new vendor.  The Hatter is about to get an influx of new goods that can be purchased with all of the butterflies that you’ve been collecting.  Soon you’ll be able to express yourself even more through your Unicorn! 

Also keep your eyes peeled for an update that will drop mid-October.  Halloween will come to the island!  Be prepared to trick or treat with your favorite unicorn characters.  Find your way through the Halloween maze for special, limited-time collectable items.  Travel around the island to see all the Halloween decorations that the unicorns have put up.  And for a limited amount of time, collect bats instead of butterflies! 

After the Halloween decorations are put away, prepare yourself for an amazing Unicorn Tails surprise!  Nope, I’m not going to spoil this one, but I will tell you this is big and will open the game up in a new, incredible way.  Look for this update in November. 

Once we have (hopefully) wowed you with our giant surprise, the weather on Unicorn Island will be shifting and getting colder.  Snow is in the forecast as we prepare for our Winter event! 

Looking forward to 2021, we are preparing a bunch of new quests and we’ll be adding new lands to explore. It’s time to leave the Island and see what else might be out there beyond the endless sea.  And somewhere within all these updates, we’ll add the ability to have multiple save files.  We promise.  We just want to make extra sure that through this change no one loses their current game progress as we overhaul that portion of the game.  We know how our kids would feel if we accidentally deleted their unicorns.  We don’t want anyone to have to go through that. 

We’ll keep you updated as things progress.  We truly can’t wait to get these updates in your hands and let you play them! 

 

Until next time, 

RavenFist Studios

notes.title: Unicorn Tails Update 0.4
notes.content:
Hey all!

We've got another update to Unicorn Tails ready and live! 

The biggest new thing in this update is the ability to shoot magic from your unicorn's horn! You can play with this new feature in PT's mini-games. There you will find a new section for all the shooting games, including basic target practice, some timed challenges, and two "horde mode" levels with some virtual bad guys.

We will be adding this ability to the rest of the game world in updates coming very soon!

Also, this update adds some new mazes for you to explore, several bug fixes and improvements, and a small change to the dialog window.

As always, we are super interested to hear your feedback on the new shooting ability. And the rest of the game too!

[h2]Patch Notes 0.4[/h2]

[list]
[*]Added the ability to shoot magic in the game! We will be expanding this system in the next several updates.
[*]Added several new levels to PT's mini-games utilizing the new shooting system, including target practice, timed challenges, and horde mode.
[*]Added some new mazes to explore - more coming soon!
[*]Made a small change to the dialog window to utilize the space better.
[*]Bug fixes and improvements
[/list]

notes.title: Unicorn Tails Roadmap 2020
notes.content:
Hello Dear Game Players!

As promised, we are publishing the 2020 Roadmap for Unicorn Tails. This is what we would like to do and where we would like to take the game. It is all malleable based on player feedback, so let us know what you think. Does this plan add fun and exciting elements to Unicorn Tails? Is there something we’ve missed that you or your children are clamoring for? Let us know!

2020 Unicorn Tails Roadmap:

Q1 –
• Magic Ability System – Already complete!
• Introduce the Maze – Already complete!
• Add additional games to PT’s Magic Machine – Already complete!

Q2 –
• Launch the first major quest of 2020 - This is a multi-phase story-driven quest that will
unfold more Unicorn Tails lore and add new fundamentals to the game.
• Begin the second major quest of 2020 - By the end of Q2, another major story-line quest will begin and will continue through 2020.
• Additional mazes and additional hazards / obstacles within the maze.
• Add the ability to have multiple save files to Unicorn Tails - Starting a new game will no longer wipe your previous progress.
• Behind the scenes code building to support future quests – You, Dear Game Player, won’t see this, but trust me, it’s important.

Q3 –
• Continuation of the second major quest of 2020
• Launch the third, and final major quest of 2020 – This is a BIG one! All the story elements
that you’ve experienced in Unicorn Tails—and will experience throughout 2020—will
culminate in this major in-game event!
• Photo mode – Hide the UI and take snapshots of your favorite moments of Unicorn Tails.

Q4 –
• Wrapping up the second major quest of 2020 – What? But you’ve already done the third
major quest. That’s true. It will make sense. We promise.
• Special holiday themed events.
• Looking forward to 2021.

In addition to those planned updates, throughout the year we will be adding more fully narrated books, more game music, more bug fixes, and more things we haven’t even thought of yet!

We hope that you’re as excited for Unicorn Tails in 2020 as we are!

Until next time,
RavenFist Studios

notes.title: Unicorn Tails 0.35 Update
notes.content:
Hey all!

We've got another update ready for you. This time around we've added the ability to sleep at any bed you find! You can nap for an hour, or sleep the night (or day) away if you choose.

We've also made some changes to PT's mini games and the maze in terms of how they look and sound. Other than that, we've got more bug and dialog fixes rolled out!

Keep your eyes open for more announcements - we've got a roadmap coming your way! Also, we are working hard on some big additions to the game that we are excited to get in your hands!

[h2]Patch Notes v.35[/h2]

[list]
[*] New sleep system: Any bed will now allow you to sleep, advancing time by your choice of hours.
[*] Fixed the issue where you would face the wrong direction upon starting or respawning at a checkpoint in PT's obstacle courses.
[*] Fixed some issues where the camera would seemingly collide with thin air.
[*] PT's obstacle courses have a new background look to them. Hopefully you like it!
[*] Added another music track to PT's mini games
[*] Added music to the maze
[*] Misc. bug fixes and improvements
[/list]

notes.title: Unicorn Tails 0.3 Update
notes.content:
Hey all!

We're excited to release another update to Unicorn Tails! This one brings us to version 0.3 and introduces a new maze to explore. Along with the maze is a quest to help find a unicorn who lost his way in the maze. We'll be adding more mazes and explorable dungeons in future updates, so keep your eyes open!

We also made several fixes and improvements to some other things in the game. You can find those in the patch notes below. 

We hope you are enjoying Unicorn Tails so far. We'd love to hear from you about some of the new features and content we've been adding - just head on over to the Feedback Forum and let us know what you think! 

[h3]Patch Notes v.0.3[/h3]

- The very first maze is now in the game! You can find it in the Southwest part of the island. Good luck!
- Added a new quest to go along with the maze. Help Billom track down his friend who is lost in the maze!
- Made changes to the camera to hopefully solve some of the terrain clipping problems. Also, you can zoom in close to the unicorn.
- When in PT's games, your unicorn now looks more "virtual".
- You can now remove magic from magic slots. Select "No ability" from the list of magic when assigning an ability to a hotkey slot.
- Misc. small bug fixes and improvements

notes.title: Unicorn Tails 0.21 Update
notes.content:
Hello all!

We've updated Unicorn Tails to 0.21! See the notes below for the changes.

[list]
[*] Fixed bug where magic abilities could be used in PT's mini-games, sometimes causing your unicorn to come out of the games invisible.
[*] Removed an invisible collider from the field by the big bridge.
[*] Reduced prices for magic abilities, added a few more butterflies to the world to collect, and changed the butterfly respawn so they will come back every two nights. This should make it easier to get the magic abilities from the shopkeeper, but not tooooo easy.
[*] Changed how the lights in the castle work at night. This reduces the number of shadows greatly, but should also greatly improve performance in the castle market at night. We will continue to tweak this to find a balance of performance and nice shadowing.
[*] Added a bit more delay for the magic help pop-up to appear when starting a new game. It was getting in the way of seeing the notification that you received quests after talking with Trixomy.
[*] Certain situations caused the grass to get a little crazy. This should be fixed.
[*] Added options to control grass distance.
[*] Tweaked the grass generation. Grass should give better performance now as there are far less actual instances of grass.
[*] Updated Magic ability icons for consistency.
[/list]

notes.title: Unicorn Tails 0.2: Magic Abilities Update
notes.content:
Greetings, Dear Game Players.

I’d like to announce the release of Unicorn Tails version 0.2! We’re excited to be able to offer not only bug fixes and optimizations, but also additions to the core gameplay of Unicorn Tails with the new Magic System!

Experience power and abilities beyond what unicorns could imagine with the Magic System! Run super-fast, jump super-high, change the weather at will, summon wheels of cheese, and much more! Earn new magic powers as you play Unicorn Tails to help transverse the environment, solve quests in new and exciting ways, and have tons of fun!

Full patch notes below.

As always, let us know if you find any issues with the game, or think of something that you’re dying to see implemented.

Until next time,

RavenFist Studios.

[h2]Patch Notes Unicorn Tails 0.2[/h2]

· New Magic System -> Find magic and abilities by doing quests, exploring the world, and purchasing them from the shopkeeper in the village. More abilities and ways to obtain them will be added in a future update

· Fixed library not appearing after quest complete bug

· Improved Bearshe's dialog tree

· Increased overall camera sensitivity

· Fixed bug where active quest wasn't showing as active on Quest panel

· Fixed several dialog typos

· Fixed bug where you could get hit again while the restart effect was playing in obstacle courses

· Fixed bug where the unicorn’s horn was still visible during restart effect in obstacle courses

· Corrected an error in Formstall's dialog

· Added a safety net just in case you manage to fall through the world ;)

· Added more video options to help tweak performance
